versions.changelog:
- Added lossless PNG compression with oxipng before delivering images to reduce file size and save tokens.
- Updated instructions and usage to ensure all delivered images are compressed unless tooling is missing (fail open).
- Improved workflow guidance: compress images right before attaching, never expose local file paths, and always deliver even if a processing step fails.
- Clarified supported processing: reading metadata, resizing, cropping, rotating, format conversion, image combining, overlays, and watermarks.
- Expanded documentation with CLI examples and troubleshooting notes for font and tool availability.
